verdict.rationale: The evidence shows developer building blocks: serverless functions to 'customize logic' and webhooks that call an external URL when a model event occurs. Neither is documented as a first-party automation feature that a user sets up to run autonomously in the background. Nothing shows functions running on triggers or schedules, or any workflow or automation builder, so these primitives earn no credit toward the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
